integrity: Mathematical proofs and finite-field checks are provided without implying independent verification or exhaustive literature priority.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced geometric solution loci are classified; low-dimensional cases n≤3 were already classified in 2018. Finite-field counting extends by proof beyond the prime fields exhaustively tested. Automorphism-conjugacy classes and nonreduced schemes are not classified.
title: Weight-dependent affine components and exact Rota–Baxter rank spectra on a split Leibniz family
